text.p: CST Entertainment Inc said late on Tuesday, after the market closed, that it filed for an extension of its form 10-K with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said it has been informed by the American Stock Exchange that trading in its common stock will be temporarily halted effective October 16, 1996, due to this delay and Exchange policy.

"The sole reason for the delay in filing year-end results is due to a serious illness of the company's principal accounting officer," said Jody Shapiro, president and chief executive officer of the company in a press release.
The company said it anticipates that BDO Seidman, its independent accounting firm, will complete its year-end audit within the next two weeks.
